# Feature: Confirm Dialog Replacing window.confirm

## Overview
Replace both `window.confirm` call sites with a small, reusable confirmation modal that renders above the existing Task modal. The current task modal uses `z-index: 1000` on `.modal-overlay` (`client/src/index.css:862`). The new confirm dialog must use a higher stacking context (e.g. `z-index: 1100` / `1200`) so it is never obscured when triggered from within or alongside the task edit flow. This unblocks consistent styling, keyboard/a11y handling, and theme-aware confirmation UX for task deletion and project deletion without touching unrelated business logic.

## User Stories
- **As an Admin user**, I want a styled confirmation dialog instead of the browser's native `window.confirm` so that confirmations match the Light/Dark theme and feel consistent.
- **As an Admin user**, I want the confirmation dialog to clearly sit above any open modal so I am never blocked by a hidden prompt.
- **As an Admin user**, I want to confirm or cancel destructive actions (delete task, delete project) via keyboard (Escape, Enter) and screen-reader labels.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
- **`client/src/components/ConfirmDialog.jsx`** (new, reusable):
  - Props: `isOpen: boolean`, `title: string`, `message: string`, `confirmLabel?: string` (default `"Delete"`), `cancelLabel?: string` (default `"Cancel"`), `variant?: "danger" | "default"` (default `danger`), `onConfirm: () => void`, `onCancel: () => void`.
  - Renders only when `isOpen` is true; otherwise returns `null`.
  - Structure: `div.confirm-overlay` > `div.confirm-dialog` with `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` + `aria-labelledby` on title. Header with title + optional close icon, body with message, footer with Cancel (`.btn-secondary`) and Confirm (`.btn-primary` or `.btn-danger-ghost` variant) buttons.
  - Interactions: overlay click calls `onCancel`; dialog click does `stopPropagation`; `Escape` key closes via `onCancel`; `Enter` when focused on confirm triggers `onConfirm`. Traps focus at least between the two footer buttons; first focus goes to Cancel for safety.
  - Styling hook: `.confirm-overlay` with `z-index: 1100` (or `1200`) and `backdrop-filter: blur(2px)` + `background-color: var(--modal-overlay)`. `.confirm-dialog` mirrors `.modal-container` but smaller (`max-width: 380px`, `padding: 1.25rem`). No dependency on task modal internals.
- **CSS additions in `client/src/index.css`**:
  - `.confirm-overlay` — `position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 1100; background-color: var(--modal-overlay); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); padding: 1rem;`
  - `.confirm-dialog` — `background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; width: 100%; max-width: 380px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); animation: modalSlide 0.2s ease;`
  - `.confirm-header`, `.confirm-title`, `.confirm-body`, `.confirm-footer` — compact spacing (footer `justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.6rem; padding-top: 1rem;`).
  - Ensure `.modal-overlay` stays at `z-index: 1000` and never raised above confirm overlay.

### Data Model (Mock)
No data model change. Dialog consumes plain strings and callbacks. Example invocation shapes:
```js
// Task deletion
{ title: "Delete task?", message: "Are you sure you want to delete \"Setup DRF\"? This cannot be undone.", confirmLabel: "Delete", variant: "danger" }
// Project deletion
{ title: "Delete project?", message: "Delete \"Sprint Board\"? Tasks will be preserved.", confirmLabel: "Delete", variant: "danger" }
```

### Simulated Backend
No backend change. This feature is presentation-only; existing delete endpoints (`DELETE /api/tasks/{id}/`, `DELETE /api/projects/{id}/`) are still called from parent handlers after confirmation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No `window.confirm` calls remain in the codebase (`grep -r window.confirm client/src` returns zero).
- [ ] `ConfirmDialog.jsx` exists under `client/src/components/`, is reusable via props, and has no direct coupling to tasks or projects.
- [ ] Confirm overlay uses `z-index: 1100` (or higher) — strictly greater than `.modal-overlay` at `1000` — verified in `client/src/index.css`.
- [ ] Task deletion in `KanbanBoard.jsx:97-108` now routes through `ConfirmDialog`; optimistic update + API delete still works, cancel does nothing.
- [ ] Project deletion in `ProjectsPage.jsx:41-50` now routes through `ConfirmDialog`; tasks preserved, list updates on confirm.
- [ ] Dialog supports overlay click to cancel, Escape to cancel, and focus/aria attributes for accessibility.
- [ ] Light/Dark themes render correctly and dialog matches existing design tokens (uses `var(--bg-card)`, `var(--border-color)`, `var(--shadow-lg)`).
- [ ] `pnpm check` and `pnpm build` pass with no new Biome errors related to this component.

## Dependencies
- **Internal**: None — this feature is independent within Sprint 3.2 (does not require utils/hooks or offline queue to function, though its delete handlers will later be wrapped by the offline queue if that feature ships).
- **External**: None. Uses existing React, CSS variables, and `lucide-react` if a close icon is added.
